notes.title: BETA 1.40!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Beekeepers![/h1]
[h2]We come to you with the new and the biggest update of "Beekeeper" so far.[/h2]

This time, [b]atmospheric phenomena and a weather map[/b] were introduced to the game. Thanks to this, depending on the forecasts, sun, cloudiness, rain or even severe storms will appear over our apiaries! We will have to ensure proper hydration of our plants - otherwise they will wither.

In addition, [b]the hero modes bar[/b] has been introduced to the game, thanks to which it will be much easier for us to navigate through the activities we want to perform. It's nighttime and your vision is poor? - pull out the lantern and light up the dark! Is some construction in your plot? - pull out the ax and just tear it down! Additionally, we've improved the hero's animations!

We've also added [b]new pets[/b] that you can meet in the game, [b]new items[/b] in the character creator, [b]new and clearer HUDs for beehives and gardens[/b], [b]new tidbits[/b] on loading screens, [b]and much more[/b]!

We hope that Beekeeper will gradually become a better product, and we are not slowing down and start working on another update right away! Would you like to see prowling wild boars and bears on your apiaries?

Good luck and only honey successes!
[i]Absolute Horizon[/i]

notes.title: HELLO WORLD!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that [i]"Beekeeper"[/i] finally saw the light of day in [b]Early Access on Steam[/b]. After many months of work, the game can meet with a wider audience, and most importantly - with your opinions!

If you decided to buy our game, we are very grateful to you. You thus contribute to the development of [i]"Beekeeper"[/i]. You need to know that new content, bug fixes and other improvements will be introduced in the game over the coming months.

If you notice any bugs in the game or have an interesting idea that you would like to share with us - write about it in the [i]"Beekeeper"[/i] Game Hub.
